admission.justification: Server selection, optional wire mirror and the two presentation paths must keep one exact version-to-revision association; silently using a roster ordinal or hiding all revision numbers for a no-family subject mislabels reviewed intent. The named assertions guard projection, no-family presentation and omission without versions.

applicability: The selected invariant or family's revision-selection display-version projection and the review's selected-subject meta/statement labels.
conditions: Each selected side copies display_version from that side's selected KnowledgeDiffItem; an absent selected side contributes neither a revision id nor a display version.

The dashboard mirrors optional version fields without defaulting them. A family meta line uses that family's own guarantees; an invariant uses the member row matching the exact selected revision id, or that side's revision-selection version when no matching row is carried.
A numeric meta label uses only a carried r<n> or numeric display version: differing known numbers show n → m, equal known numbers show one number, and an unavailable side is never assigned a number.

Statement labels use each exact selected revision's actual member/selection display version. Distinct revisions without two distinct carried versions get no revision-number pair; one selected revision may use its actual one version on both sides.
exclusions: Deriving display versions from revision UUIDs, collection positions, chronology or family membership order.
Inventing a display version for a side whose revision/version is absent.
Revision writer attribution and carried-change chips, which have a separate owner.
Selecting revision operands or defining the same-revision text-difference warning, which remain existing independent obligations.
